title: Enterprise residency concierge: SLA-weighted intake & handoff playbook
creator: Liam Chen
description:
Purpose: Create a reproducible concierge-style intake and prioritization playbook for enterprise region availability and data residency requests. This ticket produces the operational runbook used by Sales/SE/Support to: 1) quickly classify customer residency needs; 2) assign SLA-weighted priority that balances revenue, compliance risk, and engineering effort; and 3) execute a handoff to Engineering, Legal, and Ops with pre-approved compensating controls for short-term delivery.

Scope: New region requests, formal data residency entitlements (contract-level), failover/DR region guarantees, and exceptions for residency constraints (e.g., storage-only vs. compute and transit requirements). Excludes: internal infra capacity procurement details (handled by ENG capacity planning ticket), and ad-hoc support for SMB customers under existing marketplace terms.

Core outputs:
- A decision matrix (scoring) that weights Revenue ARR impact, Legal/regulatory severity, Technical complexity (onboarding, network, infra), and Customer criticality (production vs. test).
- A standard intake form for Sales/SE that pre-populates key data points (legal jurisdiction, expected qps, data classification, contract clause request).
- A prioritized SLA ladder with run-to-failure vs. guaranteed-failover options and associated pricing/commitments.
- Handoff checklist and triage tags to attach to Linear issues for Eng/OPS/Legal with required artifacts.
- List of pre-approved compensating controls & temporary mitigations (e.g., dedicated encryption keys, isolated VPC peering, audit logging retention policy adjustments) to accelerate short-term entitlements.

Success metrics: Median time from initial request to first classification (target: 24h), median time to engineering handoff (target: 5 business days for high-impact), percentage of enterprise residency requests that follow the playbook end-to-end (target: 90% by Q3), and average customer satisfaction NPS on intake (target >8).

Assumptions & constraints:
- We assume Legal will sign off on a small set of compensating controls that do not require contract amendments for short-term entitlements.
- Engineering capacity for private-region activation is limited; we need to couple scoring with a bookings/ARR threshold to gate dedicated effort.
- Some countries have non-negotiable residency laws — playbook will surface these as "regulatory blockers" requiring legal escalation.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Overpromising on failover SLAs when infra is thin. Mitigation: Define and publish clear tiers (Best-Effort, Guaranteed with Reserved Capacity) and automatic fallback policies.
- Risk: Frequent manual exceptions create operational debt. Mitigation: Timebox manual exception approvals and require product/eng review for recurring patterns; feed data into automated classifier project.

Acceptance criteria:
- Documented intake form template (Sales/SE) in Google Drive and embedded in CRM.
- Completed scoring matrix spreadsheet with sample scoring of 6 historical requests.
- Triage labels and Linear issue template created and validated with ENG and Legal.
- Playbook reviewed and signed off by Legal and Solutions Engineering.
- Pilot run with 3 live enterprise requests and retrospective notes captured.
